recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if future publisher changes stop mapping <%prettyname%> to the pretty raw JSON artifact or a separate issue expands the request to another template family.
issue_request: FHIR-3143 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for DSTU1 asking JSON example pages to include a raw payload link like XML example pages and asking raw JSON payloads to be pretty-printed for readability.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-3143-tagged source commit was found. Git history shows e820f21e89894259f99c042ea100a62eb9b16bef added Raw JSON and Raw XML links to the old example templates in July 2014, before the January 2015 Jira comment saying the request was done.
additional_context: The current templates in tools/templates preserve the behavior: template-example-json.html links Raw JSON through <%prettyname%> and also links canonical JSON, while template-example-xml.html has the parallel Raw XML structure. Current build.fhir.org output for patient-example.json.html confirms the generated page has Raw JSON and canonical JSON links, and patient-example.json is multi-line indented JSON. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no later conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current authoritative template source and current rendered build already satisfy both requested behaviors.
